sections.content: In historical Spanish, voz pasiva helps writers describe events and relationships with more distance. The structure is useful when the event matters more than the individual actor, or when two developments need to be connected in one sentence.

items.spanish: Muchas comunidades fueron afectadas por la guerra civil, aunque la violencia no se distribuyó de la misma manera en todo el país.
items.english: Many communities were affected by the civil war, although violence was not distributed in the same way throughout the country.

items.spanish: Los acuerdos fueron discutidos por distintos actores mientras la población exigía una salida al conflicto.
items.english: The agreements were discussed by different actors while the population demanded a way out of the conflict.

items.spanish: Miles de personas fueron desplazadas, y algunas familias tardaron años en regresar.
items.english: Thousands of people were displaced, and some families took years to return.

items.spanish: La población sufrió graves consecuencias porque el conflicto afectó a las comunidades durante años.
items.english: The population suffered serious consequences because the conflict affected communities for years.

sections.content: Use voz pasiva to link the historical event to its context, because B1 historical writing usually combines actions and consequences rather than presenting isolated statements.
